rules_applied: A valid exact source-specific complete witness takes precedence over unrelated unavailable or unexamined sources for the existential cumulative reconstruction indicator.
This priority does not erase other access gaps and does not make every modality complete.
Zero all-cause/fatal counts allow a suicide-death zero derivation only for the same exposed population and observation period.
Universal zero completed-suicide statement over named trials can be disaggregated to own-trial arms when identity, exposure and window are established; nonzero pooled counts cannot.
Public reconstructibility of reported outcomes is distinct from complete vital ascertainment or proof of clinical absence.
